text:
alex: noticing multiple high-severity alerts but the incident channel didn't receive pages. Alerts show delivered to our paging adapter but no page landed. anyone else seeing this?
divya: I see 15 failed deliveries in the adapter logs starting 1717203300. errors look like 502 from pager relay + header strip warnings. :thinking_face:
ops-bot: paging-adapter status: REJECTED_RESP (502) x15, last_error='upstream response' -> see /var/log/pager-adapter/2026-03-14.log (tail below).
alex: pasting tail: ```
[2026-03-14T14:55:02Z] ERROR deliverer.go:142 upstream response 502 body="Bad Gateway"
[2026-03-14T14:55:02Z] WARN headers.go:47 trimmed header: X-Incident-Route
```
oncall-olivia: i didn't get any page. Slack channel had automated create message but pagerbot didn't post?
pagerbot: failed to join channel #incidents: missing scopes or invite required (403). attempted auto-invite -> permission_denied.
samir: oh — we recently rotated the webhook proxy and the signing token rotated too. possible mismatch causing 502s + header drop.
divya: could be router middleware stripping custom headers after proxy auth layer. that matches 'trimmed header' log.
alex: customer impact check — ops-alerts targeted to enterprise-corp (SLA) had latency spike. can we confirm number of affected customers?
ops-bot: query: COUNT(alerts where delivered=false AND service="ops-alerts" AND ts>1717203300) -> 6
oncall-olivia: so ~6 alerts didn't page to oncall. two of them were SEV1 for an enterprise customer (EnterpriseCorp). they attempted API calls and saw 504s for ~10-12m.
samir: mitigation plan: 1) re-route outgoing paging to sms-relay fallback 2) temporarily add a pre-auth header passthrough 3) invite pagerbot manually to #incidents 4) roll back recent proxy deploy if tests fail.
divya: i'm doing the routing change now. curl test to proxy: ```
curl -v -H "X-Incident-Route: ops-alerts" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" https://pager-proxy.internal/dispatch
```
divya: response before change -> 502 + header stripped. applying mapping to forward to sms-relay cluster (sms-relay.internal)
alex: olivia, please do manual ringdown to oncall via phone for those two SEV1s and log call IDs.
oncall-olivia: on it. ringing primary and secondary now. will update with call IDs. :phone:
divya: reroute applied. test now: returned 200 from sms-relay and pagerbot accepted payload. test page shows up in #incidents.
samir: i manually invited pagerbot and granted channel scopes; pagerbot rejoined and posted join message.
pagerbot: joined #incidents and posted: "pagerbot: connected (v2.14)"
ops-bot: temporary mitigation status: pages delivered via sms-relay x4, slack delivered via pagerbot x2. total deliveries reconciled = 6.
alex: good. next: rotate signing key back to previous version as stopgap, then run full proxy fix later. samir can you do key rollback?
samir: starting key rollback now. ETA ~6m. will watch for 502s.
divya: also saving logs and creating a shard of headers to reproduce in staging. adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-routing-fallback
ops-bot: note: enterprise-corp effected 2 incidents, customer-facing support ticket created #SUP-894. psa: potential SLA breach for 1 customer window ~12m.
alex: ok immediate mitigation done. postmortem owners: samir (infra), divya (adapter), olivia (oncall coord). we'll schedule RCA and include detection/alert for header-trim events. please drop any outstanding traces or steps here.
divya: saved packet capture + proxy logs to s3://ops-archives/1717203333-routing-ghost/
oncall-olivia: call IDs: call-9091 and call-9092, both reached customer ops lead. they acknowledged.
samir: key rollback complete. monitoring shows no new 502s for 5m.
alex: thanks all. create postmortem draft and link in #postmortems. for now mark incident as mitigated and continue to monitor for 1h. :white_check_mark:
divya: filing postmortem draft now -> https://redwood.internal/postmortems/drafts/1717203333-routing-ghost
ops-bot: incident status changed: MITIGATED by alex at 1717203610
alex: adding note: short-term mitigation = sms fallback + manual invite. long-term actions: (a) ensure pagerbot auto-invite perms (b) reject deploys that change header passthrough without test (c) add alert when header trimming occurs >5/min.
divya: agreed. will open tickets for each.
alex: closing thread here, will follow up on RCA meeting. :eyes:
